title_en: In the Garden a Girl Sat
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, sounds like a newer folk-style song, but I cannot name an author. 'Пиле' means bird/chick and is used here as an address to the falcon.

lines.cyr: В' градина моме седеше и сокол пиле молеше:
lines.lat: V' gradina mome sedeše i sokol pile moleše:
lines.en: In the garden a girl sat and begged the falcon bird:

lines.cyr: - Соколе пиле, соколе, јас ќе те нешто замолам,
lines.lat: - Sokole pile, sokole, jas ḱe te nešto zamolam,
lines.en: - Falcon bird, falcon, I will ask you something,

lines.cyr: летни ми соколе, летни ми пиле, одлетај,
lines.lat: letni mi sokole, letni mi pile, odletaj,
lines.en: fly for me, falcon, fly for me, bird, fly away,

lines.cyr: летни ми соколе, летни ми горе, високо.
lines.lat: letni mi sokole, letni mi gore, visoko.
lines.en: fly for me, falcon, fly for me up high, over the forest.

lines.cyr: Либето ми е далеку, во таа пуста туѓина,
lines.lat: Libeto mi e daleku, vo taa pusta tuǵina,
lines.en: My love is far away, in that desolate foreign land,

lines.cyr: да летнеш пиле, одлеташ, да видиш либе што прави,
lines.lat: da letneš pile, odletaš, da vidiš libe što pravi,
lines.en: fly away, bird, to see what my love is doing,

lines.cyr: дали е уште мој или си друга љуби тој,
lines.lat: dali e ušte moj ili si druga ljubi toj,
lines.en: whether he is still mine or loves another girl,

lines.cyr: дали е уште мој или си друга љуби тој?
lines.lat: dali e ušte moj ili si druga ljubi toj?
lines.en: whether he is still mine or loves another girl?

lines.cyr: Летна ми сокол одлета, летна ми горе високо,
lines.lat: Letna mi sokol odleta, letna mi gore visoko,
lines.en: The falcon flew off, flew up high over the forest,

lines.cyr: оттаму либе здогледа, друго си моме љубеше.
lines.lat: ottamu libe zdogleda, drugo si mome ljubeše.
lines.en: from there he spotted the love, he was kissing another girl.

lines.cyr: Назад си полета и во градина долета,
lines.lat: Nazad si poleta i vo gradina doleta,
lines.en: He flew back and reached the garden,

lines.cyr: до моме застана и на моме говори:
lines.lat: do mome zastana i na mome govori:
lines.en: stopped by the girl and spoke to her:

lines.cyr: - Твоето либе лажно е и друго моме си љуби,
lines.lat: - Tvoeto libe lažno e i drugo mome si ljubi,
lines.en: - Your love is false and he loves another girl,

lines.cyr: ах, твојто срце тажно е, поарно што го изгуби,
lines.lat: ah, tvojto srce tažno e, poarno što go izgubi,
lines.en: oh, your heart is sad, better that you lost him,

lines.cyr: не жали за него, ти друго либе барај си,
lines.lat: ne žali za nego, ti drugo libe baraj si,
lines.en: don't grieve for him, look for another love,

lines.cyr: не жали за него и друго либе најди си.
lines.lat: ne žali za nego i drugo libe najdi si.
lines.en: don't grieve for him and find another love.
